jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: THE POSITION Our roster has an opening with your name on it Much of what decides whether a fan stays with FanDuel happens either side of the bet: the sign-up that takes a minute, the deposit that clears first time on a Sunday afternoon, the withdrawal that lands when we said it would, and the protections that work quietly in the background for the people who need them. We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to shape the technical direction of the systems behind that experience across FanDuel’s Customer Product Engineering (CPE) domain. CPE builds the systems fans touch first and trust most: payments and money movement, account and onboarding, geolocation, responsible gaming and player integrity, and the promotions, rewards and loyalty, campaign orchestration, personalisation and marketing messaging that shape every fan’s day-to-day experience. When CPE works, nobody notices. When it does not, a fan cannot get in, get funded, get paid or get looked after, and quality elsewhere in the product does not make up for it. The mission: make it quick and predictable for every fan to join, fund an account, get paid and be protected, in every jurisdiction we operate in, on the busiest day of the sporting calendar. Making every moment more, for our customers. Your work always follows our principle Everything Begins with the Customer. That means designing for extreme, event-driven peak load, where traffic arrives in seconds, and for a heavily regulated environment in which auditability and evidence matter as much as availability. It also means depending on other people’s systems: payment providers, identity and KYC vendors, geolocation suppliers. You build so that their bad day does not become our customers’ bad day. This is a senior individual contributor role, at the same level as our Software Engineering Directors. jobs.title: Business / Data Analyst (F/H/X) - CDI
jobs.description: 📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE Rattaché(e) au département Sourcing Groupe, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les directeurs commerciaux de Brandsplace et leurs responsables d'affaires pour élaborer et mettre en œuvre des plans à court, moyen et long terme, en organisant le suivi des performances et en facilitant l'accès aux données. Vous intégrerez l'équipe Data de Brandsplace et serez rattaché(e) au responsable des données commerciales Groupe. Votre champ d'action couvrira tous les secteurs d'activité de Brandsplace, tels que le commerce, la logistique, le marketing ou la gestion des relations clients. 🎯 MISSIONS Construire des outils de suivi de la performance : chiffre d’affaires, marge et indicateurs clés de performance (KPI). Réaliser les reportings et analyses hebdomadaires et mensuels des résultats commerciaux. Calculer les bonus sur l’ensemble du périmètre Brandsplace. Collaborer étroitement avec les Business Managers et les Directeurs Commerciaux afin de répondre à leurs besoins en matière de données. Développer des prévisions commerciales et mettre en place les processus et outils associés. Concevoir des tableaux de bord avancés sur MicroStrategy afin d’automatiser les processus de reporting. Formuler et demander des requêtes SQL complexes pour répondre aux problématiques et besoins métiers. 👉 PRÉ REQUIS Vous disposez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience dans un environnement exigeant en matière de reporting, avec notamment la création et la gestion de modèles sur Google Sheets ou Excel. Une connaissance de l’activité Marketplace est un plus. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les données provenant de sources multiples, y compris lorsqu’elles sont complexes, et disposez d’excellentes capacités de modélisation. Une expérience préalable en SQL n’est pas obligatoire, mais constitue un réel atout. Vous avez une bonne compréhension des différents métiers de la VP et de leurs enjeux commerciaux. Vous avez une excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, indispensable pour le poste.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens. Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Assistant(e) Chef(fe) de Projets Spéciaux (H/F) pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de Décembre 2026. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75). Rattaché(e) à la Cheffe de Projets Spéciaux , vos principales responsabilités seront : 1. jobs.title: Senior Media Relations Manager
jobs.description: Help make the world more hospitable The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences. You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building. If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here. About the role Let s get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this: You would own Mews relationships with the press, turning company news, product launches and leadership insight into credible coverage across hospitality, travel, technology and business media. This is a new role, the first dedicated media relations seat at Mews, so the contacts you build and the way you work will set the standard for how we deal with the press. Hospitality technology offers good stories and unusual data to pitch, and leaders here respond to press requests within about a day. You would join the Communications team within Marketing and work closely with the communications lead, the colleagues who shape our stories, and leadership, product marketing and regional marketing. Day to day you would pitch journalists directly, host press briefings, handle inbound enquiries and prepare leaders to speak well in front of the press. The role is remote first in Europe, ideally near London, Berlin or Paris where many of the journalists we work with are based, with about 10% travel to meet press and attend events such as Unfold. jobs.title: DFT Engineer
jobs.description: Meet Arago and the Aragonians Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles. The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance. Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders. Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work. What you’ll do As DFT Engineer, you will define and own the Design-for-Test strategy of our next-generation SoC from the ground up. This is not a role where you inherit an existing flow, scripts, or team — you build it. You will work closely with RTL design, physical implementation, and our test partners to make our chips manufacturable, testable, and ready for volume production. Required Skills and Experience 10+ years in DFT, with at least one full SoC tape-out owned end-to-end — not just one slice of a large team effort. jobs.description: Who we are Comand AI is building a global technology leader focused on defense & security. The company was co-founded in 2023 by Loïc Mougeolle, Marie Inuzuka and Quentin Le Pape, drawing from their unique experience at defense industry leaders and world-class tech companies. The world of defense & security are being entirely renewed by AI and robotisation: new classes of threats, new levels of autonomy and speed demands radically new solutions to protect our societies. jobs.title: Langfuse - Senior Product Engineer, Integrations
jobs.description: Why Integrations Engineering at Langfuse Your work puts Langfuse into developers’ hands. Our SDKs are downloaded 26M+ times per month, and for many developers the first thing they touch is an integration — a few lines of code that connect their favorite framework to Langfuse. When that experience is seamless, they’re wow’ed. When it’s not, we might have lost them. You’ll own that critical first impression across 40+ framework integrations. You’ll live at the frontier of LLM application development. The AI framework ecosystem moves fast — new agent frameworks, orchestration libraries, and model providers emerge every week. You’ll be among the first to instrument them, giving you unmatched exposure to how cutting-edge AI applications are built. The developers you serve are some of the most ambitious software engineers in the world, and working closely with them will make you an expert on LLM engineering yourself. Everything you build is open source and immediately visible. All Langfuse integrations are MIT-licensed. When you ship a new integration or improve an existing one, thousands of developers benefit the same day — and they’ll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on Twitter, and in our community channels. Langfuse integrates with 40+ frameworks and model providers: OpenAI SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pydantic AI, OpenAI Agents, CrewAI, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, LiveKit, and many more. You’ll own these integrations end-to-end — from initial implementation to ongoing maintenance as frameworks evolve. When a new framework gains traction, you’ll be among the first to instrument it. Design new integration patterns for emerging frameworks. When a framework or a new agent orchestrator appears, you’ll evaluate it, design the right instrumentation approach (callback handler, decorator, OTEL auto-instrumentation, or a combination), build the integration, write the docs, and ship it. jobs.title: Langfuse - Product Designer
jobs.description: Why Design at Langfuse Your work will shape how engineers build with AI. Langfuse is often the primary interface engineers use to debug, evaluate, and improve their LLM applications. The designs you ship will be used for hours each day by thousands of developers and non-developers. They'll tell you about it in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community Slack channels. Everything we build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. The design challenges here are genuinely hard. You're designing for technical users and business users alike who care about information density, speed, and precision. Traces contain dozens of nested LLM calls with massive prompts and completions. Users need to set up evaluators, manage prompt versions, configure integrations, and build monitoring dashboards before they even start analyzing results. You need to make both the setup and the daily use feel intuitive and easy. You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. Deeply understanding the problems our users solve will make you a better designer and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself. You will grow at Langfuse by Owning our product design end-to-end. You'll be the first dedicated designer at Langfuse. Today, our engineers design as they build, which has gotten us far, but we need someone who can elevate the entire experience. You'll own the design system, and visual language across the product. You'll set the standard for how Langfuse looks and feels. Making data-dense interfaces intuitive. Langfuse surfaces traces, scores, costs, latencies, token counts, prompt versions, and evaluation results. You'll figure out how to present complex, nested data in ways that help engineers find what they need fast. Simplifying complex workflows. Engine Behind 120M Processed Auctions Daily The Ad Network team builds and operates the backend services that power adjoe Ads' programmatic advertising engine. jobs.description: About Black Forest Labs We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We're creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity. Why this role FLUX models ship as open weights, which gives anyone full access to the model. Our safety efforts focus on suppressing harmful behaviors and mitigating the risk of misuse, so safety has to be built into the models themselves, not bolted on afterwards. As a Member of Technical Staff on our safety research team, you'll research and ship methods that make FLUX models safe by design: from what goes into the training data to how the models are mid- and post-trained, across images, video and the text that conditions them. This is a role with real ownership: you won't just do research on model safety, you'll shape it. The methods you build ship in FLUX models with over 75 million downloads on Hugging Face and in production at some of the largest platforms in the world. jobs.title: Interim Senior Community Manager
jobs.description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another. Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth. We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. We’re on the search for... Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it. In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other. The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. jobs.title: Senior AI Content Producer - Foto, Video, Motion (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Bei Rosental Organics bist du kein klassischer Fotograf oder Videograf – du bist der Content Multiplier. Ein Shoot wird bei dir zu 50+ Assets, ein UGC-Clip zu 30 Hook-Variants, ein Produktfoto zu 20 Format-Adaptionen. Der Meta-Algorithmus belohnt Volumen und Diversität, und genau das lieferst du: aus einer Kampagne wird bei dir ein ganzer Wochen-Feed für Paid Social. Du produzierst und multiplizierst Foto-, Video- und Motion-Content für Paid Ads, Social, CRM und E-Commerce, mit klarem Fokus auf Performance und Testing-Volumen. Du drehst und shootest schnell und hands-on mit modernem Setup: UGC, Product, Lifestyle, Studio – End-to-End und ohne Assistenz-Kette. Einen skalierbaren AI-Workflow baust du selbst auf, der Rohmaterial in Dutzende testbare Variants verwandelt: Hook-Iterations, Cutdowns, Format-Adaptions, Kontext-Wechsel, Voiceover-Varianten, Motion-Loops. Du entwickelst High-Performing Creatives für Meta, TikTok und CRM mit Fokus auf Hook Rate, Watchtime, CTR und ROAS. Mindestens 3 neue AI-Tools pro Jahr integrierst du produktiv in unseren Stack (Runway, Nano Banana, Kive, ElevenLabs, Topaz, CapCut AI, Descript – was heute liefert, ersetzt du morgen). Performance-Dashboards liest du selbst, ziehst die Insights und übersetzt sie am gleichen Tag in neue Variants und Hypothesen. Du bringst 3+ Jahre Erfahrung in Content Production für D2C/ E-Commerce, Performance Marketing oder ein hochdynamisches Growth-Umfeld mit, inklusive starker Paid-Social-Cases (Meta, TikTok). Dein Portfolio zeigt echte Performance-Ergebnisse (Hook Rate, Watchtime, CTR, ROAS) und Beispiele, wie du aus einem Asset viele gemacht hast, keine Editorial-Reels, keine Behance-Moodboards. Neue AI-Tools lernst du eigenständig und schnell: Runway, Nano Banana, Kive, ElevenLabs, CapCut AI, Descript und Topaz sind dir vertraut, und den nächsten Tool-Sprung hast du meist schon selbst identifiziert. Du drehst, shootest und schneidest selbst (≥ 85 %): Sony/Canon, Studio-Light und Natural-Light, Premiere

jobs.title: Quality Manager (all genders) – Quality & Sustainability
jobs.description: Deine Aufgaben Du bist Teil des Produktteams und verantwortest den gesamten Qualitätsbereich sowie die Einhaltung relevanter Qualitäts- und Futtermittelstandards bei mammaly. Du stehst im engen Austausch mit unseren Lieferanten, führst regelmäßige Audits durch und begleitest wichtige Produktionen vor Ort. Du analysierst regelmäßig Kundenreklamationen und überprüfst unseren Warenbestand, um mögliche Qualitätsprobleme frühzeitig zu identifizieren. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Teams im Lager und an den Produktionsstandorten zusammen. Dazu gehören auch regelmäßige Dienstreisen für Vor-Ort-Besprechungen und Abstimmungen mit unseren Partnern. Du führst detaillierte Ursachenanalysen und Untersuchungen durch und leitest geeignete Korrektur- und Präventionsmaßnahmen (CAPA) ein. Du leitest Qualitätsinitiativen abteilungsübergreifend und stellst sicher, dass diese gemeinsam mit internen und externen Stakeholdern umgesetzt werden. Du verantwortest den weiteren Aufbau unserer internen Qualitätssicherung und des Qualitätsmanagements. Dazu gehören die Implementierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Qualitätssystemen, Dokumentenmanagement, SOPs, Formularen und Richtlinien. Du unterstützt uns bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Nachhaltigkeitsstandards und ESG-Themen, insbesondere im Zusammenhang mit Lieferanten, Verpackungen und verantwortungsvollen Beschaffungsprozessen. Du koordinierst qualitäts- und nachhaltigkeitsbezogene Anforderungen im Rahmen von B Corp und weiteren relevanten Standards und unterstützt die entsprechende Dokumentation und Umsetzung im Unternehmen. Founders Office Du arbeitest direkt mit den drei Gründer:innen, bringst Struktur in offene Themen und baust Funktionen auf, bevor sie eigene Teams bekommen. Deine Verantwortungsbereiche: Customer & Coach Support: Gemeinsam mit Frederike und David entwickelst du die Prozesse, Tools und Automatisierungen weiter, mit denen wir Anfragen von Mitgliedern und Trainer:innen schnell und zuverlässig beantworten. jobs.description: About Flexport:  At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.  The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. Why Customs Matters More Than Ever International trade is under more pressure than ever before. With tariffs, shifting regulations, and geopolitical uncertainty, customs has gone from a back-office function to a boardroom priority. The recent trade crisis—sparked by Trump-era tariffs—has made customs the single most complex challenge for global businesses. For many, it’s the difference between keeping supply chains moving or grinding them to a halt. That’s where we come in. The Customs Technology team at Flexport is leading the charge. We are building the systems that help entrepreneurs and global brands navigate complexity, stay compliant, and keep the world’s goods flowing. The opportunity:  Customs brokerage is one of the largest, most under-innovated opportunities in logistics. Legacy customs brokers are stuck with outdated systems and manual processes—they simply can’t adapt fast enough. Flexport is growing fast because we’re different. We are the only big tech company in the space, and the only freight forwarder that got founded after the launch of Netscape. jobs.description: Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world s most iconic sports properties. At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset. As we continue to scale our global platform, the Senior Licensing Manager – UEFA will play a critical role in strategically growing and leading the UEFA Masterlicense business unit. jobs.title: Senior Compliance Manager & Information Security Officer (ISO) (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Become a Part of Accurids Join us and help shape the future of pharmaceutical data! At Accurids, we build the data backbone behind life-science innovation. Our pharma customers rely on us, so information security and data protection are central to how we work. That is why we are ISO 27001 certified. As we grow with our pharma customers, we are creating a dedicated role for compliance. You will own our compliance programme, act as our Information Security Officer and become the central contact for security, privacy and contract obligations. How you’ll make an impact: In your first year, you take over as our ISO, lead our ISO 27001 recertification in 2027 and get us ready for SOC 2. As our ISO, you run and develop our ISMS according to ISO 27001. You own internal GDPR topics such as records of processing, data processing agreements, data subject requests and privacy reviews. You track the security, privacy and compliance obligations in our customer contracts and make sure we stay compliant. You plan and lead internal and external audits and answer customer security questionnaires. You run risk assessments, maintain policies and lead the response to security incidents. You raise security awareness across the team through trainings and clear guidelines. What helps you succeed: At least 3 years of experience in information security, ideally in a SaaS or software company. Hands-on experience running an ISO 27001 ISMS, including certification or surveillance audits. You work independently, set priorities on your own and enjoy taking ownership and improving how things work. You explain requirements in a way that engineers, management and customers understand. You live in Germany within commuting distance of Cologne and have a valid work permit. Business-fluent English and German. It’s a plus if you have SOC 2 or data protection (GDPR) experience, hold a certification such as ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or CISSP, or know the requirements of pharma customers (GxP). Why you’ll love

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing. With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors. As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers. We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them. Our Tech Stack At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development. jobs.title: Lead Systems Engineer (Orbital Launch)
jobs.description: Lead Systems Engineer We are looking for a Lead Systems Engineer to act as the Systems Technical Authority for our orbital rocket programme. You will lead the vehicle-level systems effort, maintaining a coherent technical view of the complete vehicle and leading the definition, management, and resolution of system interfaces. Working with multidisciplinary teams across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and more, you will manage the interdependencies between technical departments and use model-based systems engineering (MBSE) to keep system-level decisions connected. Your work will lay the technical foundation for successful vehicle integration and launch. About us We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket. We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you. At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you. Key responsibilities Act as the Systems Technical Authority for the orbital rocket programme, providing vehicle-level systems leadership and maintaining technical coherence across the complete vehicle. Independently manage timely and accurate monthly closings under German GAAP (HGB), coordinating external accountants and local requirements for international entities where applicable. Prepare management accounts, variance analyses, cost-centre and project reporting, KPIs, and clear decision materials for leadership and budget owners. Support the annual budget, rolling forecasts, scenario planning, and short- and medium-term liquidity planning. Ensure robust financial controls, documentation, and compliance with accounting, tax, and internal policies, coordinate VAT and other recurring filings with external tax advisors. Lead the finance workstream for ERP implementation and optimization, covering process design, data migration and quality, testing, cutover, training, and post-go-live stabilization. Um die europäischen Klimaziele zu erreichen, müssen wir dieses Problem dringend und entschlossen angehen, und genau hier setzen wir bei Sunpeak Capital an. Wir machen den Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien investierbar und verwandeln Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und Ladeinfrastruktur in renditestarke Investments. Unser Ansatz verbindet Klimaschutz mit finanzieller Intelligenz: ein echtes Win-Win für Umwelt und Investoren. Mit unserer Kombination aus spezialisierten Beratungsprozessen, innovativen Investmentstrukturen und einem breiten Netzwerk aus Projektentwicklern ermöglichen wir privaten und unternehmerischen Investoren, den Energiewandel aktiv mitzugestalten, profitabel und nachhaltig. Wir skalieren unser Modell konsequent innerhalb Deutschlands, dort, wo die Energiewende entschieden wird. Werde Teil unseres Teams und trage dazu bei, dass Kapitalströme dorthin fließen, wo sie größten Klimanutzen und echte Rendite erzeugen. Aufgaben Deine Rolle Du übernimmst unser Marketing von den Gründern und baust es weiter aus. Einiges läuft bereits, vieles existiert noch nicht. Dein Job ist es, daraus eine Growth-Maschine zu machen: Du verantwortest Lead-Volumen, Lead-Qualität und Akquisitionskosten, testest den Funnel konsequent durch und entscheidest, welche Kanäle wie viel Budget bekommen. Wir suchen keine Person, die Briefings abarbeitet und auch keinen reinen Creative, sondern jemanden mit Performance-Mindset, der Kanäle versteht, Tests selbst aufsetzt und das Thema Growth bei Sunpeak Capital zu 100 % eigenverantwortlich ownt. Growth-Strategie und Budget: Du entwickelst mit den Gründern den Marketing-Plan, definierst Zielgruppen, Kanäle, Budgets und KPIs und steuerst Soll gegen Ist. Performance-Marketing: Unsere bezahlten Kampagnen liegen komplett bei dir. Du skalierst, was funktioniert, testest laufend neue Kampagnen und Zielgruppe

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: The opportunity How taxation, accounting and payroll work today is a pain for everyone. Still every business must do it continuously. It is the backbone our economy runs on. Enabled through AI, we are turning this often-painful process into a radically simple experience for our customers, so they can focus on what matters to them: growing their business. The role As a Senior Software Engineer, you own a product area – e.g. bookkeeping, payroll or client onboarding – and take it from problem to production. You work directly with the founders, product and our tax experts, and you decide how things get built in your area. We are past the founding phase but still very early: most of what you touch is greenfield. What you’ll own Your product area, end-to-end: Turn customer and tax-expert problems into shipped features (spec → ship → measure). APIs, data models and services: Design and build the backend your area runs on – and ship the UI on top. AI that is correct, not just plausible: Build AI-powered workflows with evaluation, fallbacks and human review where it matters. Quality and operations: Tests, monitoring and incident response for what you ship. Raising the bar: Code reviews, mentoring, and active part in hiring engineers. Our tech context (greenfield) Prefer boring tech where it matters; innovate where it differentiates. Current stack (continually evolving): TypeScript end-to-end, Next.js (React) with server-side APIs, PostgreSQL, Vercel, … Most hard problems sit behind the API: data modelling for tax logic, third-party integrations, and AI pipelines. Tooling budget for whatever makes you fast. No legacy, no yak-shaving. What you’ll bring 7+ years building and operating web applications in production, end-to-end Strong TypeScript/Node fundamentals; React on the frontend (Next.js or comparable) Backend depth: API design, relational data modelling (PostgreSQL), third-party integrations A track record of owning features from idea to production with real users Produ

jobs.description: Support-Hero & Problemlöser gesucht – Quereinstieg willkommen! Du hilfst einfach gerne anderen Menschen? Du tüftelst gerne an technischen Herausforderungen, bis sie gelöst sind? Dann passt du perfekt in unser Team! Als gewachsenes Tech-Unternehmen ist WIRECLOUD ein führender Anbieter von Cloud-Telefonanlagen. Wir suchen Verstärkung für unseren IT-Support, die Lust hat, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen. Dabei zählt für uns vor allem deine Einstellung und deine Motivation, anzupacken. Neben dem Kundensupport gehört auch die Bearbeitung von Behördenanfragen zu deinen Aufgaben. Dein Start bei uns Wir lassen dich nicht allein. Du bekommst ein strukturiertes Onboarding, bei dem du unser Team, die Systeme und die Welt der Cloud-Telefonie kennenlernst. Wir führen dich Schritt für Schritt an deine Aufgaben heran, und dein Aufgabenfeld entwickelt sich mit deinem Know-how ganz natürlich weiter. Deine Mission First Level Support: Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Bestandskunden bei Fragen rund um ihre Telefonanlage per Telefon und E-Mail (kein Sales!). Probleme lösen: Du hörst zu, analysierst technische Anliegen und hilfst dem Kunden geduldig weiter. Behördenanfragen: Du bearbeitest und dokumentierst eingehende Anfragen von Behörden nach klar geregelten Abläufen. Dein Profil Quereinsteiger sind bei uns ausdrücklich willkommen. Ein technischer Hintergrund ist ideal, aber kein Muss. Wichtig ist uns: Erfahrung im Kundenkontakt: Du hast schon im Support, in der Kundenberatung, im Service oder in einem anderen Job mit viel Menschenkontakt gearbeitet. Telefonieren ist für dich selbstverständlich, und du bleibst auch dann freundlich und geduldig, wenn es mal hakt. Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift: Unsere Kunden sind mittelständische Unternehmen aus Deutschland. Du erklärst ihnen technische Themen am Telefon und per E-Mail sicher und verständlich. jobs.description: Description Are you detail-oriented and passionate about language quality? This role involves intermittent work, with tasks assigned on an ad hoc basis throughout the year depending on client needs. Volumes and timing may vary. jobs.title: Business Development Rep, Enterprise, DACH
jobs.description: From Fivetran ’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. jobs.description: Notre solution logicielle est utilisée par des traders dans les banques et entreprises d’investissement, et traite un grand volume de données en temps réel . Pour rendre ces informations compréhensibles et exploitables, une visualisation claire, interactive et ergonomique est essentielle. L’objectif du stage est de concevoir une bibliothèque web réutilisable permettant d’afficher dynamiquement des données financières complexes (prix, volatilité, paramètres d’algorithmes) dans des graphes interactifs, en commençant par les graphiques boursiers linéaires et les graphiques à barre Open High Low Close (OHLC) Tes missions : Accompagné par un développeur expert sur ces technologies, tu développeras un prototype de bibliothèque en HTML5, JavaScript et ReactJS , intégrable dans notre logiciel, avec des exemples d’utilisation concrets . Tu mettras en œuvre des fonctionnalités avancées d’interaction (zoom, sélection, modification de valeurs) pour offrir une expérience utilisateur fluide et pertinente . Tu rédigeras également la documentation technique de la bibliothèque. jobs.title: Platform Engineer - Data Resilience and Recovery platform
jobs.description: Build and own a self-service, multi-tenant platform that keeps the critical data of 20+ customers recoverable Do you like building platforms that other teams consume, at scale, across private and public clouds, with security and tenant isolation as non-negotiables? At Schuberg Philis, the world is shifting from traditional backup to data security and resilience. We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to strengthen our Data Management-as-a-Service (DMS) team and help us build the next generation of our platform. Customer teams consume it through self-service, and they handle their own day-to-day backup and restore operations. That means you won’t spend your days on job monitoring, restore tickets or backup schedules. Your customers are internal and external engineering teams, and your product is the platform they build on. You’ll join a dedicated group of data security experts within our larger Services Team and work closely with our sbp.cloud team, who operate our self-built sovereign cloud solutions. With our plan-build-run approach, you take end-to-end ownership: you design it, you build it, you run it. The Challenge Running one platform for 20+ customers means solving the hard problems of platform engineering: Multi-tenancy by design: strict isolation of data, access, and performance between customers, on shared infrastructure. Self-service at scale: APIs, guardrails and automation that let customer teams onboard and operate independently, without tickets. Scale and resilience: 4,000+ protected endpoints and more than 25,000 recovery points generated daily, on a dedicated private cloud spanning multiple availability zones. Heterogeneous workloads: Oracle, MS-SQL, SAP, Sybase, PaaS, container platforms and VMs across VMware VCF, OpenStack, AWS, Azure and Kubernetes. jobs.description: Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun. Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine. Notre ancrage dans la région marseillaise est déjà un succès incontestable . Face à une demande qui explose et pour soutenir cette dynamique, nous passons à la vitesse supérieure et agrandissons notre équipe à Marseille. L'opportunité Rejoins notre équipe en tant que représentant(e) commercial(e) et deviens l'un des visages de la révolution digitale du secteur. Chez Salonkee, tu as l'opportunité unique de piloter des projets ambitieux, de collaborer avec des experts passionnés et de marquer de ton empreinte l'expansion d'une scale-up en plein essor. Tes missions Maîtrise du cycle de vente (A à Z) : tu pilotes l'intégralité du parcours d'acquisition de nouveaux clients pour Salonkee. Cela inclut la chasse initiale, la prise de rendez-vous qualifiés, la réalisation de démonstrations percutantes et le closing des contrats. Ambassadeur(rice) de terrain : tu mènes des présentations produits directement sur site pour démontrer, avec clarté et conviction, la valeur ajoutée de nos solutions pour le business de tes clients. jobs.title: Growth Operations
jobs.description: About Uplane (YC F25) Companies waste billions on bad ads, mismatched landing pages, and poor budget allocation. Uplane fixes this by building an AI marketing operating system. Our software supports marketing teams with static ad creation, video ad creation, landing page design, budget allocation, and more. We are building the AI software for the next generation of AI-native marketers and need an ambitious growth operator who will do whatever it takes to grow the company and build the operations behind it. About The Role We're seeking a highly motivated, German- and English-speaking growth operator to join our team full-time (on-site in San Francisco or Berlin). In this role, you work directly with the founders on everything that makes Uplane grow. You build the structures, processes and team behind a company that is scaling fast across Germany and the US, and you take on whatever is most important right now. Why Join Learn how a company gets built, from the people building it. You work directly with the founders and see every decision from the inside: what works, what breaks, and why. You build the company. Every process, tool and team you set up changes what Uplane can do next. Learn how an AI-native company runs. Tech-savvy team, high leverage, AI in every workflow. Take ownership and grow quickly. Join a fast-growing, VC-backed company. Culture: fast-moving, ambitious, fun, humble. Responsibilities Growth Projects: You work directly with the founders on whatever moves Uplane forward right now: scaling the team internationally, launching new projects. Build AI-Native Operations: AI in every workflow, no manual work that a machine does better. Build the Team: You help us find and onboard the people who build the marketing agency of the future, and you make sure new hires get up to speed in days, not months. Requirements Passion for building, you love growth, people and getting things done At least 1 year of work experience, e.g. in business development, consulting

jobs.title: Healthcare Data Consultant
jobs.description: Onze Missie Wij vertalen data naar betere zorg. Met onze inzichten maken we de gezondheidszorg betaalbaarder en verbeteren we de ervaring van patiënten en artsen. Het team Je maakt deel uit van het Financial Analytics Service team, dat momenteel bestaat uit 40 mensen met diverse achtergronden in de gezondheidszorg en data-analyse. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en onderhouden van onze oplossingen en benchmarks, die zowel medische specialisten als de planning- en controleteams in ziekenhuizen ondersteunen. Onze oplossingen helpen ziekenhuizen en medische specialisten bij maandelijkse rapportages over prognoses, het aanpakken van capaciteitsvraagstukken, portefeuillebeslissingen, het verbeteren van patiëntenzorgpaden en andere belangrijke strategische keuzes. Relevante werkervaring: Je hebt 0–2 jaar werkervaring en affiniteit met de financiële sector en/of de gezondheidszorg. Data: Je hebt een affiniteit met data en bent in staat om klanten te helpen met optimale inzichten uit onze producten te halen. Communicatie: Je kunt effectief communiceren met diverse teamleden, interne stakeholders en klanten. Je werkt nauwkeurig, signaleert trends en spoort fouten of afwijkingen op. Een proactieve benadering om nieuwe taken op te pakken en kansen te zoeken om bij te dragen. Een WO-opleiding afgerond, bij voorkeur met een focus op gezondheid, data of economie. Taalvaardigheden: Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat wij bieden: Bij LOGEX hebben we één superkracht: data-analyse. Wij kiezen ervoor deze superkracht in te zetten om de huidige problemen in de gezondheidszorg aan te pakken door gegevens te vertalen naar betere zorg. Naast een baan met een duidelijke missie bieden wij jou: Een uitstekend beloningspakket (salaris, vakantiegeld, NS Business card, fiets leaseplan, telefoon- en internetvergoeding) 25 vakantiedagen (op fulltime basis) om nieuwe energie op te doen, met de mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen Een informele werk

jobs.title: Control & Estimation Intern
jobs.description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on. These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation. Your mission The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions. Responsibilities Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment. Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines. Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution

Menjaga kebersihan dan memastikan kendaraan selalu dalam kondisi baik dan siap digunakan. Melakukan pengecekan rutin kendaraan, termasuk bahan bakar, oli, ban, dan kondisi mesin. Melakukan perawatan kendaraan secara berkala serta berkoordinasi dengan bengkel apabila diperlukan. Memastikan kelengkapan dokumen kendaraan seperti STNK dan dokumen lainnya. Menjaga privasi dan kerahasiaan seluruh informasi selama menjalankan tugas. Melaksanakan tugas tambahan terkait kebutuhan transportasi sesuai arahan pimpinan. Kualifikasi: Kualifikasi Driver Pribadi Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau sederajat. Usia 30-40 th Memiliki SIM A aktif. Memiliki pengalaman sebagai driver pribadi minimal 2 tahun. Bisa mengendarai mobil matic & mobil mewah Memiliki kemampuan mengemudi yang baik, aman, dan bertanggung jawab. Memahami perawatan dan kondisi kendaraan serta memastikan kendaraan selalu dalam keadaan bersih dan prima. Memiliki sikap jujur, disiplin, sopan, ramah, dan menjaga kerahasiaan. Sehat jasmani dan rohani serta tidak memiliki catatan kriminal. Bersedia bekerja dengan jam kerja fleksibel dan mengikuti kebutuhan perjalanan. Di utamakan domisili Tangerang/Jakarta Barat

jobs.title: Stage Consumentengedrag
jobs.description: Waarom pak je in de supermarkt het ene product wel uit het schap en het andere niet? Ligt het aan de verpakking? De prijs? Smaak? Gemak? Of simpelweg omdat het precies op de juiste plek staat? Bij Growy telen we verse sla, kruiden en microgreens in Amsterdam in onze vertical farm. Vertical farming klinkt misschien ingewikkeld, maar het idee is simpel: we telen planten in lagen boven elkaar, midden in de stad en helemaal los van het weer buiten. Nu onze producten in steeds meer Nederlandse supermarkten te vinden zijn, willen we onze consumenten nóg beter leren begrijpen. Daarom zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en commercieel ingestelde stagiair die zich wil verdiepen in consumentengedrag en inzichten kan vertalen naar echte commerciële kansen. En nee, dit wordt geen stageproject wat ergens in een lade verdwijnt en niemand ooit nog bekijkt, jouw stage gaat voor ons echt een verschil maken! 🌱 Wat ga je doen? Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat meer consumenten Growy ontdekken, proberen én opnieuw kopen? Tijdens je stage ga je bijvoorbeeld: consumenten interviewen en/of focusgroepen organiseren; onderzoeken wat mensen belangrijk vinden bij het kopen van verse salades en kruiden; ontdekken welke drempels consumenten ervan weerhouden een product te proberen; onderzoeken wat juist zorgt voor een herhaalaankoop; kijken naar kansen rondom prijs, assortiment, verpakking, positionering, promoties en zichtbaarheid; kwantitatief onderzoek, zoals enquêtes, opzetten om ideeën te testen; jouw inzichten vertalen naar concrete commerciële en marketingaanbevelingen. Aan het einde van je stage presenteer je jouw belangrijkste inzichten en aanbevelingen aan ons Sales & Marketing team. En als het binnen je stage past, kun je misschien zelfs één van je ideeën in de praktijk testen. De precieze inhoud stemmen we af op de duur van je stage en de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding. Goed om te weten; onze farm is nog volop in ontwikkeling, we zitten nog in onze start-up/scale-up fase. Dit betekent dat je naast je

jobs.title: Software Engineer AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$400-US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$400-US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience

You will report directly to the Store Supervisor Key responsibilities: Transaction Processing and Accuracy Process customer purchases accurately using POS system. Apply only approved promotions, discounts, and transaction adjustments. Issue the required invoice or other approved transaction documents in accordance with company procedures and regulations. Immediately report pricing discrepancies, POS errors, and transaction irregularities. Payment Handling and Security Accept and process only company-approved payment methods. Follow prescribed procedures for cash, card, electronic wallet, and other authorized payment transactions. Verify payment completion before releasing merchandise. Safeguard cash, payment records, and assigned cashiering equipment. Prevent unauthorized access to POS accounts, cash drawers, and transaction records. Report suspected fraudulent transactions or payment irregularities. Customer Checkout Experience Greet and acknowledge customers courteously at the checkout counter. Process transactions with accuracy and reasonable efficiency. Explain payment, exchange, and other relevant policies clearly and respectfully. jobs.title: Expert Talent Pool Physical AI
jobs.description: About the Role Lead physical AI data capture programs that help robots learn from human movement and manipulation. You will set up capture systems, guide demonstrations, and uphold data quality across projects ranging from one week to several months. What You'll Do Set up and maintain teleoperation rigs using VR controllers, leader arms, and ROS or ROS 2, ensuring consistent demonstrations. Design egocentric and manipulation capture systems, including camera placement, task scripts, and quality assurance protocols. Operate motion capture and sensor systems such as OptiTrack, Vicon, IMUs, and LiDAR, and troubleshoot hardware in the field. Plan scene recording, calibration, and data collection across multiple sites. Design robot evaluation tasks, define success criteria, and develop scoring systems. Train, mentor, and review operators and data capture technicians. What We're Looking For At least five years of hands-on experience in robotics operations, teleoperation, motion capture, sensor capture, lab work, autonomous vehicle testing, or precision hands-on trades. Practical robotics or physical AI data capture experience, such as teleoperation, egocentric or manipulation recording, or robot evaluation. Experience setting up and troubleshooting capture rigs, including ROS or ROS 2, VR teleoperation, motion capture systems, cameras, LiDAR, or IMUs. Ability to design or run capture sessions with defined protocols and quality checks. Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama biasanya melayani wajib pajak yang memiliki jenis usaha atau perorangan dengan volume transaksi yang lebih kecil dibandingkan dengan kantor pajak yang lebih besar seperti Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Besar. Kantor Pelayanan Pajak Pratama ini biasanya tersebar di berbagai wilayah di seluruh Indonesia untuk memudahkan wajib pajak dalam mengakses layanan perpajakan tanpa harus pergi ke kantor pajak yang lebih besar. jobs.description: PT Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN) merupakan institusi perbankan syariah yang berkomitmen menghadirkan layanan keuangan yang amanah, inovatif, dan berkelanjutan sesuai prinsip syariah. Rekrutmen Officer Development Program Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN). PT Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN) adalah entitas perbankan syariah baru hasil spin-off Unit Usaha Syariah (UUS) PT Bank Tabungan Negara (Persero) Tbk (BTN) yang resmi beroperasi penuh pada Desember 2025. BSN berfokus pada inovasi digital, termasuk penggunaan aplikasi Bale Syariah , dengan aset sekitar Rp71 triliun dan menargetkan pertumbuhan signifikan sebagai salah satu bank syariah terbesar di Indonesia. BSN berkomitmen menjadi mitra keuangan yang berkah dan amanah, menargetkan nasabah yang membutuhkan layanan perbankan cepat, mudah, dan sesuai prinsip syariah. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Nasional (BSN) Saat ini PT Bank Syariah Nasional memberikan kesempatan untuk kualifikasi sebagai berikut: Officer Development Program (ODP) Talent Sourcing Melalui Officer Development Program (ODP), Anda akan dipersiapkan menjadi calon pemimpin masa depan Bank Syariah Nasional melalui program pengembangan yang komprehensif dan terstruktur. Sebagai peserta ODP, Anda akan mendapatkan: Program pelatihan intensif (classical training) terkait perbankan syariah, operasional bank, layanan nasabah, serta pengembangan kepemimpinan On-the-Job Training (OJT) melalui rotasi di berbagai unit kerja strategis Pemahaman menyeluruh mengenai produk, layanan, serta prinsip perbankan syariah Pengembangan kompetensi analitis, komunikasi, dan leadership Pendampingan langsung dari mentor dan profesional berpengalaman Kesempatan berkarier dalam lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dengan budaya kerja berbasis integritas, pelayanan, dan kinerja Program ini dirancang untuk membentuk individu yang siap berkontribusi secara optimal dalam mendukung pertumbuhan bisnis serta memberikan layanan terbaik kepada nasabah. Persyaratan Umum: Lulusan Sarjana (S1) dan Magister (S2)
